purpose: Source snapshots for a bimanual OpenArm with purchased motors, PLA-first custom structures and a fixed upper-body first phase for VLA/learning-model experiments; lower body and mobile base deferred. checked_date retains the original source audit date; the 2026-11-19 material review records new local-file inspection without claiming all upstream sources were re-audited. Hardware/software/model compatibility and real-robot validation remain incomplete.

sources.name: folding_final
compatibility_notes: 16 position features ordered right arm then left arm; separate three-camera input.
Relative joint actions exclude grippers; preprocessing and postprocessing statistics must travel with weights.
Generic ACT/so100 model-card commands are not a validated OpenArm deployment recipe.
rtc_config is null in saved config; runtime scheduling must be recovered separately.
Training dataset ID is lerobot-data-collection/level2_final_quality3; identity with public HQ snapshot not verified.

unresolved: Bimanual OpenArm with purchased motors unchanged, PLA-first links/interfaces/shoulders/torso/wheel frame. Actual motor inventory, revisions, power, stops, cables, standard hardware, wheel system, battery and budget remain to be verified.

No validated PLA manufacturing CAD, structural/thermal/creep/fatigue results, motion baseline or wheel stability result. Initial metal recommendations are historical alternatives, not current procurement requirements.
Two reference Minis need 16 C046 servos at 1:147; 12 purchased SER0069 at 1:345 cannot establish either full quantity or reuse compatibility. Do not count Feetech servos as Damiao actuators.
Reference +5 cm links and jaw_normal are optional reference modifications; compatibility with 2.0 and the new PLA geometry is unverified.
B0495 is AR0234; folding reference uses a wide-angle fixed-focus IMX708 candidate. D405 reuse requires actual view and capture tests; it is not automatically equivalent to checkpoint inputs.

Validate per-side eight-position and combined sixteen-position field order, units, signs, J6/J7 remapping, gripper conversion, cameras, timing and processor statistics. Equal action dimension does not establish policy compatibility.
KER CAD/BOM exist but end-to-end reproduction remains unverified. Motor firmware, CAN hardware, host control and collection stack still need matched checks.
NCT is the user-provided application term and remains undefined; do not silently rename it ACT.
New geometry, attachment details, mass/center of gravity, shoulder width, collision clearance and thermal effects remain unvalidated; do not inherit the prior extra 85 mm shoulder offset per side.
current_phase: Fixed bimanual upper body first. Recorded-observation SmolVLA and ACT inference measured on 2026-11-19; see offline_inference. Closed-loop tasks and PLA structure/control validation remain incomplete.

offline_inference.scope: No hardware actuation, task success evaluation, closed-loop simulation, training or PLA validation.
